name: Pillow Press
description: Press down on a foe's will with a soft heavy dream until the foe's arms grow slack.

name: Counterpane Sense
description: Lay a thin sheet of attention over a sleeping room and feel where each dreamer lies.

name: Bolster Ward
description: Prop up a bolster of dream force against the body that cushions a strike.

name: Soft Smother
description: Smother a foe's alertness under thick folds of dream until the foe can barely lift a hand.

name: Rest Weaving
description: Weave a deep rest around a hurt ally in which the body knits and the mind is quiet.

name: Dream Spoiling
description: Spoil a hostile dream the instant it forms so the foe's spell collapses in a muddle.

name: Pillow Trap
description: Hide a heavy pillow of sleeping force along a path that drops on the foe who steps there.

name: Smothering Quilt
description: Draw a vast quilt of dream over a company of foes so each sinks beneath its weight.

name: Cushioned Realm
description: Make a whole room a cushioned realm of dream where allies rest and foes sink under sleep.

name: Closing Reverie
description: The court's closing reverie that puts foes to sleep and mends allies with a depth scaled to the dreamer's reserve.

name: Cobalt Haze
description: Cast a blue haze across a foe's thoughts so the foe loses the line of the fight.

name: Dreamline Reading
description: Read the dreamline that runs between sleepers and trace it back to the dreamer who is causing it.

name: Blue Bolster
description: Brace the body with a blue bolster of dream force that spreads the shock of a blow.

name: Azure Drift
description: Drift through the blue dream in a long glide that outpaces a foe's reach.

name: Waking Mend
description: Wake an ally with a bright dream that carries healing into every part of the ally's body.

name: Cobalt Lull
description: Hum a deep cobalt lull that draws a group of foes slowly down into sleep.

name: Sky Unthreading
description: Unthread a dread from an ally's mind one strand at a time against a clear blue sky.

name: Blue Lull
description: Spread a blue expanse of dream across the ground that sleeps whoever walks into it.

name: Azure Immersion
description: Immerse a foe wholly in the blue dream until the foe cannot tell sky from ground.

name: Boundless Azure
description: Dissolve into the blue dream and step out of it at another place the dreamer chooses.

name: Azure Apogee
description: The rite's highest move that lifts a whole field of minds into one blue dream with a reach scaled to the dreamer's reserve.

name: Brimming Doze
description: Spill a brimming doze onto a foe from the Core's basin and slow the foe's every motion.

name: Deep Gauge
description: Gauge the depth of a sleeper's dream and decide how much force the dreamer must spend.

name: Stillwater Guard
description: Hold a still pool of dream force before the user that drowns the force of a strike.

name: Rest Draught
description: Give a hurt ally a draught of the Core's sleep that mends the body in a few breaths.

name: Overflowing Lull
description: Let the basin spill over in a long lull that carries a whole line of foes under.

name: Pooled Mending
description: Gather the healing sleep of the basin over a wounded ally until the wounds close.

name: Mind Draining
description: Drain a poison or dread from an ally's mind into the basin and let it sink away.

name: Level Dreaming
description: Level an ally's frayed nerves with the still surface of the basin until the ally fights steady.

name: Sleep Reservoir
description: Bury a reservoir of dream force under a field so it breaks open beneath the foes who cross.

name: Flooded Mind
description: Flood a foe's mind with so much dream that the foe cannot find a waking thought.

name: Unfathomed Rest
description: Sink a foe into a rest too deep to fathom from which the foe cannot rise on the foe's own.

name: Boundless Sleep
description: The basin's signature tipping that floods a whole battlefield in sleep with a depth scaled to the Core's fullness.

name: Oath Doze
description: Speak a short sleeping oath that makes a foe's eyelids sink for a heartbeat.

name: Vow Listening
description: Listen for the vow a sleeper speaks in sleep and learn what the sleeper will defend.

name: Wind Bolster
description: Prop up a bolster of moving air and dream force that turns a blow aside from its line.

name: Pledge Lull
description: Lull a foe into sleep on the strength of a pledge that no friend will come to harm.

name: Windfall Rest
description: Give an ally a windfall of rest that comes without effort and heals the body.

name: Pledge Loosening
description: Unbind a hostile oath of sleep that has been laid on an ally and free the ally's mind.

name: Pledge Net
description: Spin a net of pledged sleep around a camp that sleeps any foe who crosses it.

name: Sworn Trance
description: Hold a foe in a sworn trance that lasts as long as the dreamer keeps the oath.

name: Oathbound Dreaming
description: Seal a foe's arts inside a dream the dreamer has sworn to keep until dawn.

name: Sleeper's Oath
description: The oath's signature vow that guards every sleeper near and sleeps every threat with a power scaled to the dreamer's resolve.

name: Sky Hush
description: Drop a hush from the open sky onto a foe and stifle the foe's cry and step.

name: Stillness Sense
description: Go quite still and feel every small stir in the dreams of those who sleep around.

name: Cloud Bolster
description: Pad the body with a cloud of dream force that dulls the weight of a blow.

name: Sky Drowse
description: Spread a drowse across the sky above a group of foes so every one of them sags.

name: Rainfall Rest
description: Let a soft rainfall of dream settle on an ally and wash the pain from the body.

name: Mist Clearing
description: Clear the mist of a mind-curse from an ally with a clean high wind of dream force.

name: Stillness Walk
description: Walk through a hushed dream where no footfall sounds and no eye catches the user.

name: Quiet Zenith
description: Cast a quiet over the high point of the sky that hushes every foe beneath it.

name: Hushed Snare
description: Leave a hushed snare of dream on the ground that mutes and sleeps the first foe to step.

name: Silent Firmament
description: Hush the sky itself so every mind-attack loosed beneath it dies without effect.

name: Everlasting Hush
description: The rite's last hush that stills every moving mind under the sky with a reach scaled to the dreamer's reserve.

name: Bearing Doze
description: Knock a foe off the foe's bearing with a doze so the foe swings at the wrong place.

name: Wayfinding Sense
description: Sense which way a sleeper's dream is heading and where it will end.

name: Lee Bolster
description: Raise a bolster of dream force to leeward that breaks the push of an attack.

name: Journey Rest
description: Lay an ally down for a short restful journey through dream that eases the ally's hurts.

name: Far Lull
description: Lull a foe from a long way off with a thread of dream that never frays.

name: Remote Mending
description: Send a mending sleep across a gap to a wounded ally the dreamer cannot reach.

name: Distant Cleansing
description: Cleanse a distant ally's mind of dread through the dream they share.

name: Lost Heading
description: Take a foe's sense of direction so the foe walks away from the fight.

name: Uncharted Dream
description: Trace a dream no map shows over the ground so the foes who enter it lose their way and sleep.

name: Beyond Bearing
description: Cast a foe's mind past every bearing it knows into a place it cannot name.

name: Dream Horizon
description: Step to the far horizon of a dream and out of it again at any place the dreamer can see.

name: Unmoored Dream
description: The book's signature cast that takes a foe off every bearing into sleep with a reach scaled to the Core.
